reality_corrected_rank_drift_bounds_prog.definition: Reality-corrected rank counts false query answers above a valid gold, with half weight for ties; hypothetical true alternatives are filtered at both checkpoints.
reality_corrected_rank_drift_bounds_prog.inequality: D_false >= known_false_above_after - all_possibly_false_above_before. Before upper can use raw scores without assuming benchmark positives are sound; filtered upper requires their soundness.

paired_fixed_truth_drift_progress.definition: D_false=sum_e z_e*(w_after(e)-w_before(e)); z_e is fixed unknown falsity of the same dated query answer. Each weight is strict-above1/tie0.5/below0; absent before candidates contribute0.
paired_fixed_truth_drift_progress.bound_scope: Exact coordinate-wise logical bounds conditional on accepted labels, fixed dated truth, identity and candidate availability. Cross-query identity consistency can constrain attainable population combinations; no population point estimate.
paired_fixed_truth_drift_progress.organization_scenario: Prior dated named-organization/affiliation labels, at actual event occurrence date; excludes lifetime labels.
paired_fixed_truth_drift_progress.personal_action_scenario: Additionally requires dated new personal action by the deceased person; excludes retrospective reporting/posthumous publication as answers. This stricter interpretation is not established as ICEWS coder semantics.
paired_fixed_truth_drift_progress.benchmark_soundness_scenario: All existing exact-date benchmark positives also assumed worldtrue; independent external-only scenario does not require this.

paired_fixed_truth_population_bounds.method: One-sided finite-population hypergeometric tail inversion; at least certified positivecases in fixed random40. Conditional sound labels and common scenario semantics required. Posthoc exploratory, not preregisteredconfirmatory evidence.
paired_fixed_truth_population_bounds.conditions: Fixeddatedtruth, acceptedindependentgold, datedorganizationidentity; personal scenario additionallyexcludeshistorical/posthumouspublication answers. No replacementor source-basedsampling. Scenario semanticvalidity cannotbe suppliedbyconfidencebounds.
